pending.title: OIL STRONG LONG | OIL - supply getting tighter
pending.body:
🛢 OIL — supply getting tighter

WTI drops to near $97.50 as US waives Russia oil sanctions - FXStreet  (FXStreet)

WHY: Fewer barrels reaching the market than people expected. Buyers chase what is left, so the price goes up.

SILVER →    no clean read - measured against the call
